title: Normalization of a power moment
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $r\in\mathbb R$ be nonzero, and let $u:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be pointwise nonnegative. If $\mathbb E[u^r]>0$ under the uniform measure, then $\mathbb E\!\left[\left(u/(\mathbb E[u^r])^{1/r}\right)^r\right]=1$.
replaced: Let $r\ne0$, let $u:\{0,1\}^n\to[0,\infty)$, and assume $A=\E[u^r]>0$ under the uniform measure. Then $\E[(u/A^{1/r})^r]=1$.
